items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Miles Davis phrasing... Even Miles [Davis] in Bitches Brew... Miles, and everything else will be the equivalent to the three B’s

ctx.x: Killer, killer. Phrasing: Miles Davis phrasing, Lester phrasing. Everything. Pitch, feel, unbelievable. You’ll see. Adjectives don’t cover it.
When you think that you’re really one of a kind – who were the mentors? Who were the people? Because I can’t even find a model for what you do.
